comment: The hardware has an on-board condenser microphone. The plugin links to no audio device, so neither param 2 (Microphone) nor param 3 (Mic Sensitivity) has a microphone signal to act on. Param 2 has no panel position and no widget, so it can never be clicked and is left untagged; param 3 is drawn on the panel and clickable, and is tagged to a line saying nothing reads it.
